item.title: Rallying Cry – August 6, 2026
item.description: Nigerian forces rescued over 300 hostages, robots are helping Japan’s cherry blossom farmers, a high schooler invented eco-friendly plastic, and Australia granted citizenship to two Iranian footballers seeking asylum.
